objective: Build the first real self-build backend bridge: compile a bounded implementation brief from repo truth, emit backend handoff artifacts, and validate backend-result evidence before any release-gate claim.
validation: handoff brief must be generated from current repo truth
handoff must define allowed files, forbidden scope, and required proof
backend result manifest must be physically present and schema-aligned
validator must refuse PASS if backend result evidence is missing
release gates must remain PENDING until this phase closes
